entities.summary: A yellow ribbon has various uses. It can be applied as a necktie, worn on a person, mounted on a car, or wrapped around a tree. In the United States, it has many different purposes, most commonly associated with forgiveness and hope. yellow ribbon is a symbol. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
